versions.content: Leaving state BUDGET_EXHAUSTED Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_13000 The BUDGET_EXHAUSTED state can only be left by calling BudgetReplenish or us- ing an Alarm with action OsAlarmBudgetReplenish or a related action at an expiry point of a ScheduleTable. If the replenish succeeded (the current execution budget of the Task is >0) then the Task will change to state READY . Afterwards a rescheduling may happen.
